theorem m65WeakDisk_conformal_of_normalized_minimum (g : RiemannianMetric 3 M)
    (he : ContMDiff (𝓡 3) (𝓡 N) ∞ e)
    (hinj : ∀ p, Function.Injective (mfderiv (𝓡 3) (𝓡 N) e p))
    (hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding e) (compact : IsCompact (univ : Set M))
    (hgamma : Continuous gamma) (F : M65WeakDisk e gamma)
    {a b c : LoopCircle} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hmin : F.MinimizesNormalizedEnergy g a b c) : F.Conformal g :=
  m65WeakDisk_conformal_of_minimum g he hinj hemb compact hgamma F
    (F.normalized_minimum_is_minimum g he.continuous hgamma hab hac hbc hmin)

tex_content.label: lem:annular-disk-conformal
tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Conformality of the weak minimum] ↗ lem:annular-disk-minimum ↗ lem:annular-energy-competitor

The minimum $u$ is weakly conformal: its two weak derivative columns have equal metric norm and are orthogonal almost everywhere.
Proof

Write their Gram coefficients as $a,b,c$ and $e_0=(a+c)/2$. A compactly supported Beltrami variation with parameter $t u $ gives the exact energy

\[ \int _{\mathbb D} rac{(1+t^2| u |^2)e_0 -t\{ \operatorname {Re} u (a-c)+2\operatorname {Im} u \, b\} }{1-t^2| u |^2}. \]

Its derivative at zero vanishes by minimality and dominated convergence. Real and imaginary test functions yield $a=c$ and $b=0$. No differentiable dependence of the chosen coordinate maps on the variation parameter is required.

□
